Bozeman City Commission Regular Meeting

January 7, 2025 - 6:00 PM

City Hall, Commission Room, 121 N Rouse Ave, Bozeman, MT

Roll Call

Members Present:

  • Mayor Terry Cunningham - present
  • Deputy Mayor Jennifer Madgic - present
  • Commissioner Christopher Coburn - present
  • Commissioner Emma Bode - present
  • Commissioner Joey Morrison - present

CONSENT AGENDA

1. Approve minutes of the December 17, 2024 Regular Meeting

2. Authorize City Manager to sign professional services agreement with HDR Engineering

For water treatment plant upgrades estimated at $2.4M

3. Accept the annual financial audit report from Anderson ZurMuehlen

PUBLIC HEARING

4. Ordinance 2145: Annexation of 45 acres at Baxter and Davis

Applicant requests annexation for planned residential development

5. Resolution 5678: Special Improvement District for N 7th Ave infrastructure

ACTION ITEMS

6. Award contract for Kagy Blvd reconstruction project

7. Adopt updated Parks and Recreation Master Plan

Motions and Votes

Motion by Commissioner Coburn to approve the Consent Agenda. Second by Commissioner Bode.

The motion passed unanimously (5-0).

  • Cunningham - Aye
  • Madgic - Aye
  • Coburn - Aye
  • Bode - Aye
  • Morrison - Aye

Motion by Commissioner Morrison to approve Ordinance 2145.

Second by Deputy Mayor Madgic.

  • Cunningham - Aye
  • Madgic - Aye
  • Coburn - Nay
  • Bode - Aye
  • Morrison - Aye

The motion passed (4-1).

Public Comments

Commissioner Bode said "We need to ensure affordable housing is part of every annexation conversation going forward."

Mayor Cunningham stated: "This commission remains committed to responsible growth that serves all residents."
